text:
lauren-docs: PR #4123 ready — updates Zephyr-mini-quant model card with SDK v3 snippet and CPU fallback example. Can someone sanity-check the code example and the link to the quant profiles doc? https://redwood.example.com/docs/quant-profiles

miles-ml: I'll take a look in a bit. Is the fallback example meant to show edge CPU behavior or just a soft-degradation note?

lauren-docs: Soft-degradation note + small code snippet showing explicit fallback to fp16 model variant when quantized kernel not available. Also added a short benchmark table (very rough numbers).

sam-engineering: Quick read — snippet looks fine but SDK call uses `client.generate()` which in SDK v3 is `client.responses.create()` now. Also need to import `SDK3Client` not `LegacyClient`.

lauren-docs: ah right 🤦‍♀️ good catch. I'll update.

toni-qa: FYI the QA deck flagged that the sequence length example still references a 4096 limit. Zephyr-mini quanted supports only 2048 when quantized; native fp16 supports 4096. Need to call that out.

lauren-docs: added a note: "quantized models: max_sequence 2048; fp16 variants: max_sequence 4096". Is wording clear?

rachel-ux: wording is okay. Maybe add an inline callout: "If you need >2048 tokens, use the fp16 variant or enable split-chunking in client." Short sentence is fine.

miles-ml: Also the benchmark numbers under the table show 2.3ms/token for GPU — that seems optimistic for small edge; probably 23ms/token. I pushed a comment on PR.

lauren-docs: changed table numbers per comment.

deploy-bot: CI started for lauren-docs/zephyr-mini-card PR #4123 — build 9821.

ci-bot: Lint warning: docs/snippets/zephyr-mini.md: line 42: unused import `LegacyClient`.

lauren-docs: removed legacy import and replaced snippet with SDK3 usage:

```python
from redwood_sdk import SDK3Client
client = SDK3Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp = client.responses.create(model="zephyr-mini-quant", input="Summarize...")
print(resp.output_text)
```

sam-engineering: Nice. Also add a link to the SDK migration guide instead of embedding long diffs: https://redwood.example.com/sdk/migration/v3

lauren-docs: added link and short note. Anything else?

toni-qa: Please add test vector for a prompt that triggers long-context fallback; we'll verify behavior.

lauren-docs: added minimal prompt in examples and a note to QA. Marking for final review.

miles-ml: LGTM aside from one nit: the compat matrix row for "CPU quant fallback" should reference the right kernel: `q8_0` vs `q4_0`. I left a PR comment.

lauren-docs: fixed.

rachel-ux: Approved the language. :thumbsup:

lauren-docs: thanks all — merging tomorrow after CI passes. I'll post in #eng-ml once live.

deploy-bot: CI passed for lauren-docs/zephyr-mini-card PR #4123 — build 9821.

lauren-docs: merged. thread closed. :tada:
